blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The ban on Discord was lifted on Thursday, Sept. 24 after its representatives talked with officials of the Cybercrime Investigation and Coordinating Center (CICC) and the Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT). DICT chief Henry Aguda and CICC Executive Director Undersecretary Renato “Aboy” Paraiso made the confirmation. The ban was removed after Discord officers promised to cooperate with the two government agencies. The parties met in an online meeting on Thursday.
